dominant_intent: Multi-shape concrete quantity / order estimate
secondary_topics: concrete yards; bags of concrete; concrete volume
overlap_review: Volume, slab, cost and pour: broad entry point; shape tools add detail
specific_recommendation: Explain requested waste versus supplier rounding and direct users to the Waste tool.
title: Concrete Calculator — Cubic Yards, Bags, Weight & Cost
description: Calculate concrete for slabs, walls, footings and cylinders in cubic yards, bags and weight, with waste allowance and optional material cost.
formula: Slab/footing: V = length × width × thickness × quantity. Wall: V = length × height × thickness × quantity. Cylinder: V = π × (D/2)² × H × quantity.

dominant_intent: Paint volume and whole containers for four room walls
secondary_topics: paint gallons; how much paint; wall paint

title: Paint Calculator — Wall Area, Gallons & Containers
description: Estimate wall paint from room dimensions, excluded openings, coat count, product coverage, container size and purchasing allowance.
formula: Wall area = 2 × (room length + room width) × wall height − excluded area; paint = area × coats × allowance factor / coverage.

dominant_intent: Bulk gravel volume, weight and supplier quantity
secondary_topics: gravel yards; gravel tons; how much gravel
overlap_review: Crushed Stone and aggregate are material-specific variations
specific_recommendation: Source density presets to supplier/product references where possible; clearly label compacted vs loose state.
title: Gravel Calculator — Yards, Tons, Metric Volume & Cost
description: Calculate gravel from dimensions, known area or volume with density presets or custom density, separate compaction and waste allowances, metric/US outputs and optional cost.
formula: Measured gravel volume comes from dimensions, known area × depth or known volume. Order volume = measured volume × (1 + compaction allowance) × (1 + waste allowance). Weight = order cubic yards × selected or custom bulk density.

dominant_intent: Mulch volume and bags for measured rectangular beds

title: Mulch Calculator — Yards, Bags & Cost
description: Estimate mulch in cubic yards and whole bags from bed dimensions, placed depth, identical beds, bag volume and purchasing allowance.
formula: Mulch volume = length × width × depth × beds; bags = ceil(volume × allowance factor / bag volume).

dominant_intent: Sloped roof area and packaged roofing materials

description: Calculate sloped roof surface from building footprint, overhang and pitch, then show allowance-adjusted material area, roofing squares and metric area.
formula: Roof area comes from footprint × slope multiplier or known sloped area. Allowance-adjusted area is divided by each product’s effective coverage for whole package counts.

dominant_intent: Convert pitch, angle, slope and straight rafter geometry
secondary_topics: pitch to degrees; rise and run; roof slope
overlap_review: Roof Slope offers same formulas/near-identical intent
specific_recommendation: Maintain clear primary pitch ownership; investigate actual GSC overlap before consolidating Roof Slope.
title: Roof Pitch Calculator — Ratio, Angle & Slope
description: Convert roof rise and run or supported pitch inputs into pitch ratio, angle, percent slope and roof-surface multiplier.
formula: Slope = rise/run = tan(angle) = pitch/12. Angle = atan(slope). Surface multiplier = √(1+slope²). Rafter length = run × multiplier; reverse mode uses rise = √(rafter² − run²).

dominant_intent: Floor area, allowance and whole package coverage
secondary_topics: flooring boxes; room flooring area
overlap_review: Hardwood, Laminate, Vinyl reuse the same formula and defaults

title: Flooring Calculator — Area, Coverage & Cost
description: Calculate net floor area, allowance-adjusted coverage, whole packages to order, purchased coverage and optional material cost from product package coverage.
formula: Net area = length × width − excluded area. Pattern allowance and waste are applied separately, then order area is divided by package coverage.

dominant_intent: Roll-strip purchase area and carpet quantity

formula: Strips = ceil(room width / roll width); purchased length = strips × room length × allowance factor; purchased area = purchased length × roll width.

dominant_intent: Straight-layout tile count and whole boxes
secondary_topics: how many tiles; tile boxes; tile quantity

title: Tile Calculator — Tiles, Boxes, Layout & Cost
description: Calculate straight-layout tile rows, columns, whole-tile and whole-box quantity from surface and tile dimensions, with grout joint, allowance and optional box/area pricing.
formula: Tile count uses tile face area and, in rectangular-dimension mode, a conservative full-row/full-column layout. Boxes = ceil(order tiles / tiles per box).

dominant_intent: Slab quantity, bags, edge concrete and subbase
secondary_topics: slab yards; slab bags; concrete pad
overlap_review: General Concrete handles multiple shapes; Slab Cost broader cost
specific_recommendation: Keep unique slab outputs prominent; cite product bag yield rather than using competitors as formula authorities.
title: Concrete Slab Calculator — Yards, 40–80 lb Bags & Cost
description: Calculate slab concrete from length, width and thickness in cubic feet and yards, with 40/50/60/80-lb bag counts, waste allowance, weight and optional cost.
formula: Rectangle: V = L × W × T × Q. Circle: V = π × (D/2)² × T × Q. Thickened edge (planning approximation): V_edge = perimeter × edge_width × (edge_depth − T) × Q. Optional subbase: V_base = footprint area × base depth × Q. Supplier rounding: ceil(order ÷ increment) × increment.

dominant_intent: Wall/ceiling sheet takeoff, coverage and ordering
secondary_topics: drywall sheets; Sheetrock calculator
overlap_review: Drywall Sheet is known-area sheet coverage

title: Drywall Calculator — Room Walls, Ceiling & Sheet Count
description: Estimate drywall sheets for a rectangular room from wall dimensions, openings, optional ceiling area, sheet coverage and purchasing allowance.
formula: Area = 2 × (length + width) × height + optional ceiling area − openings; sheets = ceil(area × allowance factor / sheet area).

dominant_intent: Fence-run material layout and post/panel/picket quantity

description: Estimate installed fence posts and sections or panels from a continuous run and specified maximum post spacing, with spare quantities and optional panel cost.
formula: Sections = ceil(run length / maximum post spacing); posts = sections + 1 + additional posts.

dominant_intent: Deck-board rows and stock board quantity

description: Estimate straight-layout deck boards, stock-board quantity, joist lines, fasteners, surface area and optional board cost from entered project dimensions.
formula: Rows = ceil((deck width + gap)/(board width + gap)); boards per row = ceil(deck length / stock length); total boards = rows × boards per row.

dominant_intent: Straight modular paver layout, base and sand

title: Paver Calculator — Paver Count, Rows, Columns & Cost
description: Estimate straight-layout paver rows, columns, installed pavers and order quantity from area dimensions, paver size, joint width and allowance.
formula: Rows = ceil((area width + joint) / (paver width + joint)); columns = ceil((area length + joint) / (paver length + joint)); installed pavers = rows × columns; order quantity = ceil(installed pavers × allowance factor).

dominant_intent: Compacted asphalt volume and weight

description: Calculate a slab rebar grid from dimensions, centerline edge offset and maximum spacing, with bar counts, equalized centers, total footage, stock bars, weight and cost.
formula: Grid dimensions = slab dimensions − 2 × centerline offset. Bar count per direction = ceil(usable dimension / max spacing) + 1. Total cut length = count × perpendicular grid dimension.

dominant_intent: Excavation geometry, bank and loose haul volume

formula: Bank volume integrates the expanding rectangular excavation from bottom dimensions and entered side slope. Loose haul volume = bank volume × (1 + swell/100).

dominant_intent: Bank/loose/compacted state conversion
secondary_topics: earthwork swell; shrink; compacted soil volume
overlap_review: Cut and Fill balances quantities; Excavation derives cut geometry

title: Earthwork Calculator — Bank, Loose & Compacted Volume
description: Calculate bank earthwork from dimensions or known volume, then show loose and compacted equivalents from entered swell/shrink factors plus optional bank-yard cost.
formula: Bank volume comes from dimensions or direct entry. Loose volume = bank × (1 + swell); compacted equivalent = bank × (1 − shrink).
